## Actual captures

- Before: genuine macOS Desktop Home from product build `3f29dd4ae36db6fa89e72705d4cba8cf0cb33bd1`, 2522×1640, dark, Chinese. It shows composer and unread summary without embedded creation or four cards. Its model setup label is not missing-credential evidence: that Tob already had its own working plan.
- Initial after captures: actual isolated Web, 1440×900, dark, Chinese, on product dca. Synthetic QA identities differ; compare available surfaces rather than pixels across platforms.
- Dashboard: real four-owner queries, precise 24h/7d/30d, explicit refresh without a generated report and recent Channel opens Messages beside mounted Home. Positive retained usage follows real provider Turns.
- Creation: actual section-plus entry, blank/Git/ZIP switching with destination/draft retention, then fresh blank Bot creation and canonical section/DM readback. Root blank form is embedded, name-first and optional settings folded.
- Conversation: one Home submission produced a real arithmetic reply through `channel_send`, a completed Turn and handled delivery. A canonical snapshot observed the Tob root live. Its first Web working screenshot left that card offscreen; the separate native working capture actually shows it.
- Product62 question: a real native `ask_user_question` creates Home actionCount1; its button opens the exact Channel card beside mounted Home. The canonical Human answer removes the action and resumes a completed native Turn with its real Channel reply.
- Product62 approval: a real scoped `deepseekbot settings-set` request creates Home actionCount1; its button opens the exact pending card. Human denial removes the action, leaves value and revision unchanged, and completes the Turn with `approval-denied`.
- Product62 missing model: a task-only final launch Patch selected an unavailable native default while Tob inherited. Home replaced composer with setup; setup opens and cancellation retains Home, with unchanged Channel message IDs and no model request. In that same actual no-model state, blank/Git/ZIP forms retained their section/drafts and a fresh blank Bot was created into that section. No dependency installation or machine configuration change; original AX default and exact official Tob Orchestrator route were restored.

All successful journeys above had no browser page errors. Light/dark and supported 1024×650 vertical scrolling/draft retention passed on the initial product-equivalent creation tree. Below961px the existing compact Bot DM path replaces Workspace/Home; this PR preserves that boundary.

## Preserved failures and remaining gates

The first actual Gateway SRC error and locale/selector failures are preserved. An initial real question and a later settings Shell waited without canonical cards. Pinned RC2 Remote forwarding could run before the asynchronously registered application owner; the bounded fix prepends the same guarded owners. Exact ownership/live-Agent/call/tool/scope checks remain unchanged, unknown requests delegate once, terminal decisions/errors do not fall back, and Fiber disposal unregisters the adapters. The original question was Human-cancelled; the settings Shell timed out without changing its setting. The same paths now pass actual Web verification on product62.

The first fixed question driver used the wrong terminal status for a legacy indefinite question: its existing status becomes `expired` after settlement. The canonical answered resolution and completed replying Turn prove success; the corrected public phase asserts those actual owner contracts. The verification-only failure is preserved.

The initial missing-model attempt was refused because native settings were overlaid by a launch Patch; its generic full-plan restoration also lacked an Assignment choice. Both failures are preserved, and restoration was completed through the supported owner. The successful task-only launch fixture described above avoids both errors.

The initial product's four macOS journeys passed independently; see native-evidence.md. Native requalification of the later owner-order fix, full CI, Human QA and final integrated-stack qualification remain distinct gates. Actual Git clone/ZIP import execution and degraded/partial usage runtime are not qualified by form switching; existing owner/rendered tests cover unknown/partial/degraded and actual task recency. No merge or deployment is authorized.
